journey.title: Leave the saved departure date untouched and change the passengers
journey.goal: Moving through the date field without picking a date leaves the submitted departure date unchanged

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: A picked date still shows in the configured dateFormat
guards.goal: Picking 25 October in a datepicker configured with a long date format shows "October 25, 2026"

plan.root_cause: The datepicker component reformats the input's value to a locale-specific string (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY) during initialization, even when no date is selected. This causes the form submission to use the formatted string instead of the expected ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD).
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the datepicker component to: 1) Skip updating the input's value during initialization, 2) For input elements, set the value to the ISO string of the selected date (first date for single mode) on date selection or display updates, 3) For display elements, update with the formatted string for UI, 4) Ensure the display element reflects the initial date when the calendar is shown.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The date picker will continue to function correctly for keyboard and screen reader users. The input field will retain its ISO string value for form submission while displaying formatted dates in the associated display element (if present) or allowing the user to see the ISO string in the input when no display element is configured. This change does not affect focus management or aria attributes.
functional_risks: If the datepicker is used in multiple selection mode, the input's value will only reflect the first selected date (consistent with single mode behavior for input elements).
Inline datepickers that rely on the input's value being updated during initialization may need adjustment, but the bound input (hidden) will still receive the comma-separated ISO strings.
The display element will now be updated when the calendar is shown, which may cause a brief visual update if the calendar is shown repeatedly.
verification_requirements: Verify that submitting the form without changing the departure date yields 'departure=2026-10-22&passengers=2'.
Verify that selecting a new departure date updates the input's value to the ISO string of the selected date.
Verify that the return date (which uses a display element) continues to show the formatted long date string.
Verify that keyboard navigation (Tab, Escape, Enter) still works as expected for the date picker and form fields.

reasons: Regression guard "A picked date still shows in the configured dateFormat": failed · #return-shown: expected "October 25, 2026", observed "2026-10-25"

plan.root_cause: The datepicker component treats all input elements the same when updating the value after a date selection. The departure date picker (trigger input with data-bs-toggle) should retain ISO format for form submission, while the return date picker (non-trigger input) should display the formatted date per its configured dateFormat. The original code sets the input's value to the formatted date for all inputs, which would break form submission for the departure picker. The previous attempt set all inputs to ISO, breaking the return picker's formatted display requirement.
plan.repair_strategy: Distinguish between trigger inputs (with data-bs-toggle="datepicker") and non-trigger inputs. For trigger inputs, keep the input's value as ISO (first selected date) for form submission. For non-trigger inputs, update the input's value with the formatted date for display. This is done by adding a _isTriggerInput flag set during initialization and using it in _syncSelectedDates.

    this._isInline = this._config.inline

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The date picker continues to function correctly for keyboard and screen reader users. Trigger inputs (like departure) retain ISO values for form submission, while non-trigger inputs (like return) display formatted dates per the configured dateFormat. Focus management and ARIA attributes are unchanged.
functional_risks: If a trigger input is used without a form, it will still show ISO format, which may be less user-friendly but ensures form compatibility.
Non-trigger inputs without a displayElement will show formatted dates in the input itself, which is the desired behavior for display-only date pickers.
verification_requirements: Verify that submitting the form without changing the departure date yields 'departure=2026-10-22&passengers=2'.
Verify that selecting a new departure date updates the input's value to the ISO string of the selected date.
Verify that the return date picker shows the formatted long date string (e.g., 'October 25, 2026') after picking a date.
Verify that keyboard navigation (Tab, Escape, Enter) still works as expected for both date pickers and form fields.
